theorems.name: Submission.ts_pwb_pair_weight_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (a : RectifiablePair n ℓ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (mk a).weight ∧ ∀ g : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ, ∫ y, g y ∂(mk a).weight = ∫ y in a.M, a.θ y * g y ∂μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
